Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.server

Interface PlayerEditAuthority

public interface PlayerEditAuthority
Loader-specific protection checks for packet-driven player gestures. The mod's custom packets take the place of the vanilla interactions the client suppresses, so implementations re-run the checks a vanilla interaction would have triggered on that platform: world/spawn protection and whatever interaction event claim or logging mods hook.

  • Method Details

    • claimInteraction

      boolean claimInteraction(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer player, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos markPos, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos... consulted)
      Gates a stack access and claims the click for it: every position in consulted must clear the platform's protection and interaction checks before the gesture may act. markPos is the position a vanilla click that still follows the packet, on platforms where one does, should be suppressed for.

    • claimItemUse

      boolean claimItemUse(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer player, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos markPos, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos... consulted)
      Gates a gesture that spends the held item and claims the click for it, the way claimInteraction(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos...) gates one that only reaches the block. A deposit takes the stack straight out of the hand on the click, so it requires permission to use the held item as well as permission to reach the block.

    • claimPlacement

      boolean claimPlacement(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer player, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos againstPos, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos intoPos)
      Gates an item-driven placement of a block into intoPos against againstPos and claims the click for it. Both positions are checked: the block being used against governs the interaction, while the position being filled governs the placement, and they can fall on opposite sides of a protection boundary.

    • mayInteract

      boolean mayInteract(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer player, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos)
      Whether player may access the stack at pos, without claiming the click.
